PullRequest.Title: Correct ExtensionGalleryAuthProvider policy minimumVersion
PullRequest.Body:
The `ExtensionGalleryAuthProvider` policy declared `minimumVersion: '1.137'`, but the `extensions.gallery.authProvider` setting first ships in 1.144 (`package.json` is 1.144.0 on main). This aligns the policy with the release that introduces it.

Follow-up to Copilot's review comment on #325804.

Validation: one-line metadata change; no tests run.

Scenarios.Scenario: Workbench startup registers extension configuration and policy metadata
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Module evaluation synchronously registers the existing extensions configuration schema; the changed value only replaces one five-character string literal in an already-created policy object.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One statically declared policy entry, independent of installed extension count, workspace size, or user activity.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous registry call; no queue, limiter, fan-out, or asynchronous work is introduced or changed.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache lookup, key, invalidation, coalescing, or negative-cache behavior depends on minimumVersion; registry ownership and lifetime are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that startup CPU, allocation, and retained-memory behavior are unchanged because the hunk only replaces the contents of an existing scalar field.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material: both old and new values have the same length and the diff does not add work or retained objects.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: the diff changes declarative policy compatibility metadata without changing registration frequency, object count, or startup boundaries.

Scenarios.Scenario: Headless policy-data export discovers, serializes, and writes policy definitions
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After installed extensions and remote configuration load, export enumerates all configuration properties, optionally reads distro metadata, serializes the policy catalog, and writes one output file. minimumVersion is copied into the existing DTO and does not control any branch or loop.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Read DISTRO_PRODUCT_JSON or package.json while resolving distro policy metadata.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One environment-selected file read, or one package.json read per export invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same file read occurred once per export before this metadata correction.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before policy serialization completes, but unchanged by the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch distro product.json from the GitHub API when no local override is supplied.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one HTTP request per export invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single fallback request occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Blocks completion of headless policy export in the fallback path; the changed minimumVersion neither adds nor selects this path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Write the generated policy-data JSON file.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one write per successful export invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same one-file output was generated before the diff; only one scalar value in its contents differs.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Final required export step, unchanged by the diff.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One serialization of all discovered policies per export invocation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same full-catalog serialization occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs immediately before the output write; the old and new minimumVersion strings are equal length, so serialized size and complexity are effectively identical.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Total registered configuration policies and extension policy references; the diff changes one existing scalar and does not change effective collection cardinality.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The export awaits configuration loading, distro retrieval, and the final write sequentially; the changed scalar does not alter sequencing or concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No new cache is added or bypassed. Configuration data is taken from the already-populated registry once; distro retrieval behavior and lack of additional coalescing are unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence from tracing the sole consumer of schema.policy.minimumVersion: it is copied as data and later rendered, not used to schedule boundaries or alter collection traversal.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Export duration varies with extension registration and the existing filesystem/network path, but none of that duration or cardinality is changed by this hunk.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: existing O(number of policies) traversal and single serialization/read/write or network operations are unchanged.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance review of the sole changed hunk. The policy minimumVersion correction changes only declarative/exported metadata and introduces no additional CPU work, allocation, retention, I/O, network calls, concurrency, or critical-path latency.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
